description: This file generates precomputed elliptic curve tables for P256 in the BoringSSL cryptography library, including functions to create tables of multiples and combinations of the generator point, and writes them to C header files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that calls table writing functions for P256.

methods.name: writeP256NistzTable
methods.description: Generates and writes the precomputed table for P256 NIST curve to a header file.

methods.name: writeP256Table
methods.description: Generates and writes the base point precomputation tables for P256 to a header file.

methods.name: makeMultiples
methods.description: Creates a table of the first n multiples of 2^shift * G on the elliptic curve.

methods.name: makeComb
methods.description: Creates a table of 2^size - 1 points representing combinations of the generator point.

methods.name: toMontgomery
methods.description: Converts a big.Int to Montgomery form modulo the curve's prime.

methods.name: bigIntToU64s
methods.description: Converts a big.Int to a slice of uint64 words.

methods.name: bigIntToU32s
methods.description: Converts a big.Int to a slice of uint64 words representing 32-bit chunks.

methods.name: writeIndent
methods.description: Writes indentation spaces to an io.Writer.

methods.name: writeWords
methods.description: Writes a slice of words to an io.Writer with formatting and wrapping.

methods.name: writeBNMont
methods.description: Writes a big.Int in Montgomery form as a sequence of uint64 words.

methods.name: writeU64Mont
methods.description: Writes a big.Int in Montgomery form as a sequence of 64-bit words.

methods.name: writeU32Mont
methods.description: Writes a big.Int in Montgomery form as a sequence of 32-bit words.

methods.name: writeTable
methods.description: Writes a table of elliptic curve points to an io.Writer.

methods.name: writeTables
methods.description: Writes multiple tables of elliptic curve points to an io.Writer.
